I'll fix both files:

The problem was a field name mismatch. The API returns `complexity.avgComplexity` (as seen in the report JSON you shared), but both the TypeScript type and the component were referencing the non-existent field `avgCyclomaticComplexity`, causing it to always resolve to `undefined` and display `—`.

Two fixes made:

1. **`src/types/api.ts`** — Updated the `complexity` interface to match the actual API response fields (`avgComplexity`, `maxComplexity`, `totalMethods`, `methodsAboveThreshold`, `threshold`).
2. **`src/pages/QualityReports.tsx`** — Changed the "Avg Complexity" metric card to read from `report.complexity?.avgComplexity` instead of the old `avgCyclomaticComplexity`.

With these changes, the Avg Complexity value (e.g. `3.6`) will now display correctly on the Quality Reports screen.
